name: Authentication
layerWhy: It is a place where several cells (sign-in, sign-up, reset) serve one journey: getting in.
promise: Get in, get an account, or get back in when the password is lost, each at its own address.
expectation: A narrow column with the product's name, one question at a time, no card.
evidence: Each place restores from a cold link; a mismatch says so beside the form with the reset; every place links to the other two.
behaviour: The email typed at sign-in carries to the reset.
The reset never says whether an account exists.
relationships: Next two moves: switch between sign-in and sign-up, and reach the reset.
accessibility: Autocomplete hints for password managers; errors under fields.
failures: Never a card around the form.
do: Carry what was typed between places.
dont: A sign-in in a modal over the product.
